cli.argparse.help: show this help message and exit
cli.help.allow_final_seed: Allow a seed from seeds.final in a real-provider run (offline mock trios are never refused). Running one before the final campaign looks at final data; refused unless given.
cli.help.allow_mock: Accept mock runs. Only for exercising the workflow offline; a real budget comes from real spend.
cli.help.balance: Supply and demand of every good in run logs: gathered and used, made and bought, and what was left (reads logs only).
cli.help.behavior_audit: Judge every activation of real runs by the behaviour obligations (reads logs only).
cli.help.behavior_audit_out: Write the audit as JSON to this file.
cli.help.behavior_check: Ask the real model in situations built for each rule the agents must follow (and, with --from-log, in real moments where a run broke one), and judge every answer by every rule that applies.
cli.help.behavior_from_log: A run log whose missed obligations become situations, rebuilt with today's prompts (repeatable).
cli.help.behavior_moments: Moments taken from each log per missed obligation.
cli.help.behavior_only: Comma-separated situation names, or base names covering all their variants (default: all).
cli.help.behavior_reps: Answers asked per situation and condition.
cli.help.break_lock: Replace a lock left on another host, or one that cannot be read. A lock left on this host is replaced without it, and a lock another run holds never is. Only when no other run is using the directory.
cli.help.budget_fraction: SMOKE-2 budget as a fraction of SMOKE-1's measured consumption.
cli.help.budget_layer_out: Where to write the derived budget as a configuration layer (YAML) to add to the experiment's configuration.
cli.help.budget_out: Where to write the derivation and its evidence (JSON).
cli.help.campaign_plan: Show the pre-registered run matrix, and price it when pilot logs are given.
cli.help.check: Summarize how the agents behaved in run logs (finished or still running): actions, invalid outputs, refused actions and, in A, how the Director spread its tasks.
cli.help.check_logs: A run log or a directory of run logs (searched recursively).
cli.help.condition: Run only this condition of each selected trio (A, B or C); the trio is verified once all three have run.
cli.help.config_show: Load a configuration and print its hash.
cli.help.confirm_cost: Confirm a real-provider batch by repeating the projected total exactly.
cli.help.dashboard: Show a read-only observation view of a run log.
cli.help.derisk: Run the model de-risk comparison (documentation, not model selection).
cli.help.derive_budget: Derive the Experiment 2 token budget from pilot logs.
cli.help.economy_check: Run a rule-based simulation and print an economic sanity check.
cli.help.efficacy_allow_mock: With --pilot-logs, read mock runs too. Only for exercising the check offline; a mock run says nothing about LLM agents.
cli.help.efficacy_pilot_logs: With --shock-efficacy: read finished pilot runs from this directory and compare each run's shock phase with its own last W base ticks, instead of running offline twins
cli.help.experiment: Budget regime: experiment_1 (equal activations) or experiment_2 (equal tokens).
cli.help.horizon: Horizon in ticks for the comparison runs.
cli.help.include_pilot: Also analyse pilot seeds (exploration only; pilot seeds are never used for inference)
cli.help.layer: Additional configuration layer, merged in order. Repeatable.
cli.help.locale: Output language. Falls back to SIM_LOCALE, then 'en'.
cli.help.log: Where to write the event log.
cli.help.log_path: Path to the run log to observe.
cli.help.model_pricing: Per-model prices for comparison models, e.g. gpt-5-mini=0.25/2.00 (USD per 1M input/output tokens).
cli.help.no_replay: Only run the trio; do not render the replay.
cli.help.no_resume: Run every trio again; existing logs are moved to previous-N/, never deleted.
cli.help.paper_figures: Draw the paper's figures, in every language, from run logs and the report's results.json.
cli.help.paper_out: Output directory; one folder per language
cli.help.paper_results: results.json written by the report command
cli.help.paper_workers: How many logs to read in parallel
cli.help.phase: Which seed set to use: pilot or final.
cli.help.pilot: Run or price one stage of the pilot.
cli.help.pilot_scenario: Run only this scenario of the stage, in the stage's folder.
cli.help.pilot_seed: Run only this pilot seed of the stage, in the stage's folder; running the whole stage later skips it.
cli.help.plan_out: Where to write the plan and its cost estimate (JSON).
cli.help.profile_logs: Directory of mock run logs used to project token cost.
cli.help.real: Call the real provider instead of the offline mock. Needs pricing, a confirmed cost and --spend-limit-set.
cli.help.replay: Render an interactive replay of a recorded run or trio.
cli.help.replay_config: Configuration the runs used, for the crafting guide. Ignored if its hash does not match the logs.
cli.help.replay_good: Good to show in the chart initially.
cli.help.replay_out: Where to write the replay pages; defaults to reports/.
cli.help.replay_source: A trio directory (A/B/C logs) or a single run log.
cli.help.report: Analyze finished run logs and write the report in every language.
cli.help.report_allow_mock: Analyze mock runs too. Only for exercising the report offline; mock results are not evidence.
cli.help.report_logs: Directory holding the run logs (searched recursively)
cli.help.report_only: Re-report an already-executed comparison without spending anything.
cli.help.report_out: Output directory; one folder per scenario and experiment, then one per language
cli.help.runs_out: Directory for the run logs; one folder per trio.
cli.help.shock_efficacy: Run each pilot seed with and without the shock (rule-based agents, offline) and report whether the shock moves its target
cli.help.smoke: Run the two real-provider smoke verifications.
cli.help.smoke_report_only: Re-report the already-executed smoke checks without spending anything.
cli.help.spend_limit_set: Acknowledge that a provider-side spend limit is in place.
cli.help.trio: Run one seed-paired trio (conditions A, B and C) and render its replay.
cli.help.trio_out: Directory for the three run logs; the replay goes to <out>/replay.
cli.help.verify_only: Re-verify a completed stage's billing without running anything.
cli.help.workers: How many trios to run concurrently.
dashboard.exhausted: Token budget exhausted at tick {tick}; mechanical ticks continued to the horizon.
dashboard.note.read_only: Read-only view, built entirely from the run log. The dashboard is an observation tool and never part of the experiment.
error.budget.code_digest: {path}: its code digest {recorded} is not the current code's {current}; a budget measured on other code does not fit the final runs.
error.budget.condition_missing: The pooled median must not privilege a condition, but no runs were found for {conditions}.
error.budget.config_mismatch: {path}: the run used a different configuration.
error.budget.integrity: {path}: its trio ({directory}) has not passed the integrity gate, or a log changed after it did; only verified trios set the budget.
error.budget.mock_run: {path}: a mock run; the budget is derived from real spend.
error.budget.no_authoritative_total: {path}: the log predates authoritative token accounting; the budget is derived from provider totals.
error.budget.no_runs: No admissible pilot runs: the budget is derived only from {scenario} runs under experiment_1.
error.budget.no_token_accounting: {path}: no token accounting recorded; did the run finish?
error.budget.not_pilot_phase: {path}: its recorded phase is {phase}, not pilot; only pilot runs set the budget.
error.budget.not_pilot_seed: {path}: seed {seed} is not a pilot seed.
error.budget.pilot_incomplete: The pilot is incomplete: pilot seeds {seeds} have no complete A/B/C trio of {scenario} under experiment_1 at the full horizon; the budget is the pooled median of the whole pilot.
error.budget.prompts_differ: {path}: its prompts differ from the current code ({prompts}); a budget measured on other prompts does not fit the final runs.
error.budget.python_version: {path}: ran on Python {recorded}, not {current}; the budget is derived in the environment the final runs use.
error.budget.seed_incomplete: Seed {seed} has only {conditions}; every seed must contribute A, B and C, or the pool would favour a condition.
error.budget.short_horizon: {path}: ran {ticks} ticks, not the full {horizon}; the budget is derived at the horizon the final runs use.
error.budget.unbilled: {path}: not every call was billed by the provider; the Experiment 2 budget must come from billed spend.
error.cost.no_profile: no measured runs: build a mock profile before pricing a campaign
error.cost.unmeasured: no measured runs for condition {condition}; cannot price {scenario} / {experiment}
error.pilot.bad_horizon: stage {stage}: the horizon {ticks} must be a whole number of cycles ({cycle} ticks each) shorter than the full horizon {full} (campaign.pilot_calibration_horizon)
error.pilot.base_too_short: stage {stage}: the base phase ({ticks} ticks) is shorter than the volatility window ({window}); the recovery reference could not be computed
error.pilot.recovery_too_short: stage {stage}: the recovery phase ({ticks} ticks) is shorter than the hold requirement ({hold}); recovery could never be observed and every run would censor
error.pilot.shock_too_short: stage {stage}: the shock phase ({ticks} ticks) is shorter than the volatility window ({window}); its volatility could not be measured
error.plan.no_budget: the plan includes Experiment 2 but budget.experiment_2_total_tokens is not derived; run derive-budget on the pilot logs and add its layer to the configuration (design v1.0 s8.4)
error.plan.pilot_seeds: the pilot uses {count} seeds; design v1.0 s11.4 specifies {min}-{max}
error.plan.seed_floor: {scenario} is {tier} and needs at least {floor} final seeds; {used} configured
error.report.config_mismatch: {path}: the run used a different configuration.
error.report.duplicate_run: {path}: a second run of condition {condition}, seed {seed} (the first: {first}).
error.report.incomplete_trios: {scenario}/{experiment}: incomplete trios for seeds {seeds}; every seed needs A, B and C.
error.report.mock_run: {path}: a mock run; mock runs are analysed only with --allow-mock.
error.report.no_admitted_logs: {path}: none of its {count} logs is admitted to the analysis; inference reads final-phase runs on the final seeds.
error.report.no_complete_trio: No cell has an admissible complete trio: {skipped} cells without a complete A/B/C trio, {rejected} trios rejected by the integrity check, {refused} cells refused for mixing code versions.
error.report.short_horizon: {path}: ran {ticks} ticks, not the full {horizon}; the analysis compares runs at the planned horizon.
error.report.unreadable: {path}: the run metadata cannot be read.

report.note.censored_excluded: Recovery time is analysed by survival methods, never by the paired Wilcoxon: a censored observation is a lower bound, not a measurement.
report.note.common_horizon: Secondary analysis of Experiment 2: each trio is cut at the earliest budget exhaustion among its three runs, so all conditions are compared over the stretch where all of them could act.
report.note.companion_outcome: A market too thin to price is an effect of the architecture, not a gap in the data about it. Reported as an outcome in its own right and tested on the pairing, like recovery within the horizon.
report.note.contrast_suppressed: Contrast suppressed: measurability differs between conditions, so comparing only the surviving pairs would condition the result on which runs happened to trade. See "{companion}" for the pre-registered robust companion.
report.note.contrast_suppressed_no_compa: Contrast suppressed: measurability differs between conditions, so comparing only the surviving pairs would condition the result on which runs happened to trade. Measurability itself, above, carries the comparison.
report.note.dropped_pairs_column: Dropped: seed pairs with no usable value in one of the two conditions, left out of that contrast. See measurability above.
report.note.few_pairs: Few seed pairs; interpret with caution.
report.note.holm: Holm correction applied per metric within this scenario.
report.note.incomplete_trios: Seeds left out for an incomplete A/B/C trio ({count}): {seeds}
report.note.measurability: Runs carrying a usable value. Insufficient data is reported as missing, never as zero: a phase with too few trades has no measurable dispersion, and scoring it 0 would read as perfect stability.
report.note.median_suppressed: Suppressed: measurability differs between conditions, so medians over the seeds measurable in every condition would describe the runs the treatment let trade. See the contrast section and the measurability rows.
report.note.medians_pairable: Medians are taken over the n seeds with a usable value in every condition; measurability per condition is reported below.
report.note.mock_runs: WARNING: these runs used the offline mock, not a language model. The numbers exercise the pipeline and are not results.
report.note.no_pairs: No seed pair carried a value in both conditions; the contrast cannot be computed.
report.note.pilot_seeds: EXPLORATION ONLY: this analysis includes pilot seeds. Pilot seeds are for calibration and are never used for inference (design s11.4); the tests below describe the pilot, not the experiment.
report.note.primary_contrast: Primary contrast: A vs. B. A–C and B–C are secondary.
report.note.propagation: Pre-registered secondary analysis: how the shock reaches the main finished product of the affected resource. Censored like the primary recovery; its price and stockouts are contrasted above.
report.note.recovery_no_pairs: No recovery test for {pairs}: recovery is not measurable on any seed in both conditions.
report.note.recovery_suppressed: Recovery tests withheld for {pairs}: whether recovery could be measured differs between the two conditions, so comparing only the measurable runs would condition the result on it. They stay in the Holm family; measurability, below, carries the comparison.
report.note.recovery_suppressed_no_pairs: Recovery tests withheld for {pairs}: recovery measurability differs between the two conditions and no seed is measurable in both, so there is no test; it is not counted in the Holm family.
report.note.refused_cells: Cells refused, their runs mix code versions ({count}): {cells}
report.note.rejected_trios: Seed trios rejected by the integrity check ({count}): {trios}
report.note.skipped_cells: Other cells left out whole, no complete A/B/C trio; conditions present in parentheses ({count}): {cells}
report.note.skipped_logs: Logs left out before the analysis ({count}): {reasons}
report.note.skipped_seeds: Seeds left out of the whole analysis, not in the analysed seed set ({count}): {seeds}
